notes: Owner report 2026-10-23 (screenshot of Tenant Management > Platform Finance > Wallet & P&L): every Monthly profit & loss row reads Invalid Date. Root cause in providers/parity/platform-finance.mjs pnlPayload: monthOf took String(value).slice(0, 7), but pg returns timestamptz columns as Date objects, so keys were weekday-month strings such as 'Fri Oct' (rows split by weekday, and the panel's YYYY-MM label parser shows Invalid Date). The same function also counted every payment_transfers row regardless of environment (sandbox test-account transfers in the production totals), counted test-account organizations' fees, and counted transfers that never moved money (ready) or came back (returned, reversed). The fix keys months by UTC calendar month (YYYY-MM), filters transfers to the running environment, leaves test-account organizations out of production P&L, and excludes ready, failed, canceled, cancelled, returned and reversed transfers. The top cards were already summed across all rows; they change only where sandbox, test-account or unsent rows exist. Expected live 746c89a6 is main's bytes since the 2026-10-21 live reconciliation (read-only production inspect run 39577337627 found the live module verbatim); the guarded REPLACE refuses if the live member differs. No SQL change; no money moves.
